name: Wyatt Earp
summary: A rummy-style outlaw-capture card game where players build color sets to grow rewards and compete for shares of each bounty.
rules_text: The game is played over multiple hands. Seven outlaw colors exist. Setup: 10 cards dealt to each player, remaining cards form a draw pile with one discard. Each outlaw has a reward poster starting at $1000. On your turn you must draw: either 2 from draw pile or 1 from discard. Then you may play any number of outlaw cards of one or more colors, but at most one sheriff card. The first play for a color must be a set of at least 3 same-color outlaws. Later any number can be added. When you play N cards of a color, add (N-1)*$1000 to that poster's bounty. Sheriff cards modify CP and bounty: Photo adds 4 CP and $1000, requires color already opened; Stagecoach and Bank Robbery require a shot - reveal top draw card, succeed on outlaw (bullet hole) then add 1 CP+$3000 or 2 CP+$1000. Other sheriffs steal, block, etc. You must discard one card to end turn, with no effect. When draw pile empties first time, reshuffle discard except top card. When it empties second time, hand ends and each poster is split among players proportional to CP in that color. Most total money after agreed number of hands wins.
rating_reason: Rummy-like outlaw capture with shared rewards, hidden hands.
